generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Mild Steel Park Benches Supply, Transportation, Installation of Mild Steel (MS) Park Benches with Nano-Coated Wooden Finish (Teak/Rosewood Grains).The MS benches are manufactured from mild steel. The benches are treated with metal epoxy primer, jet black coating, and nano-coated with clear wooden finish Teak/Rosewood grains. The final finish is between 70 to 90 microns, made to endure corrosion, rust, oxidation, and is also protective against UV dama ge. The bench is made to withhold a seating capacity of225 kgs. The benches are composed of 2mm thick 20x40mm pipes for the seat and 20x40mm for the backrest, with 7 pipes for the seat and 6 pipes for the backrest.
